title: 第二十五章 大功告成第二十六章 溜须主任
slug: 诸天影视从四合院开始
content_zh:
叶晨在拉脚师傅的帮助下，将所有的自行车零部件都搬进了自己的屋内，如果换个季节，说不定还能在外面操作，现在这个季节，还跑外面得瑟的话，那纯粹是在耍票儿，是对自己身体的不负责，这种缺心眼儿的事，叶晨是坚决不会去做的。
搬完了零部件，叶晨给拉脚师傅递上了一支烟，然后给他倒了杯水，说道：
“师傅，今天可真多亏了您，要不然这些活全都我自己干，我绝对会头疼得很！”
这时只见拉脚师傅接过了叶晨递来的烟卷儿，对于喝水倒是没什么兴趣，毕竟这天寒地冻的，屋子里还没烧火呢，也不可能有热水，只见他凑到叶晨跟前点了个火，美美的吸了口烟，然后说道：
“您太客气了，我干的就是这个活计，就指着您这样的主顾关照，下次再有这种活想着找我就成。”
叶晨笑着点头答应了下来，然后送拉脚师傅出了院子，这一进一出的工夫，让阎解成看了个真切，开口问道：
“叶晨，你这是买了什么啊？我看东西不老少呢！”
对于这种事情，叶晨压根儿就没想着隐瞒，直接开口说道：
“我去五金商店买了些自行车的零部件，打算给自己攒一辆自行车骑骑。
毕竟买自行车还要自行车票，自己攒，只要买零件就足够了。”
阎解成听完叶晨的话，简直都要惊掉了下巴，他没想到叶晨会有这样的想法，在他看来，自己就是在听神话，这玩意儿也是能自己拼吧拼吧就成的？他觉得叶晨在跟他满嘴跑火车，也就没再多做理会，直接回了屋。
叶晨笑了笑，也没再多做理会，这个时代的人，接受新兴事物的能力跟后世还是比不了的，而且这种东西眼见为实，耳听为虚，不相信才是常态。
回到了屋里，叶晨给自己换了一套干活的衣服，然后带上了套袖和手套，开始了自己的工程。
叶晨早就有了组装自行车的想法，自然是提前就做了准备，他给车间主任买了包烟，在他睁一只眼，闭一只眼的情况下，在自己师傅的帮助下，给自己做了许多的小工具，什么钢丝扳手，六角套筒扳手，六角改锥，花扳手，钢凿子之类的。
其实组装自行车这种事情，真的就是难的不会，会的不难，别的不说，就拿一个简单的编辐条来说，你看着好像是很简单，真上了手才会知道其中的难度，这种事情不经过实践是完全没办法理解的。
叶晨买的都是各种散到不能再散的零部件，这样会节约很多的成本，就拿一个自行车轱辘来说，电视剧里，傻柱偷着卸了三大爷阎埠贵的车轱辘给卖了，最后易中海在修车铺买了一个，花了五块钱，而叶晨买辐条和钢圈外加里带外带也不过花了不到三块钱，一下子节约了将近一半的成本。
只见叶晨的双手好像是穿花蝴蝶似的编着辐条，没过一会儿，一个车轱辘就编好了，然后开始下一个。
都编好了以后，叶晨开始给钢圈上车胎，几分钟的工夫就上好了。
接着叶晨开始操作下面的步骤……
两个小时过去了，叶晨最后把车座上好，一辆崭新的永久牌锰钢二八杠自行车矗立在了眼前，叶晨用新买的打气筒，给车打好气，然后用前段时间带回来的柴油洗了洗手，用棉纱擦干净，接着又从蜂窝炉上拎过水壶，兑了些凉水，重新洗了一遍，换了身衣服，准备骑着自行车出去溜一圈儿，顺便犒劳一下自己，毕竟已经错过了饭点儿。

当叶晨推着崭新的二八大杠自行车出现在院儿里的时候，阎解成正好吃完晚饭，正要出门溜溜弯儿，一眼就瞧见了叶晨的自行车，阎解成的眼睛都直了，他感觉自己就跟看了场魔术似的，下午的时候，他亲眼看见叶晨带着拉脚师傅拉回一堆零件，结果转身的工夫，还真让这小子给变成了自行车。
阎解成的妻子于莉和丈夫在阎埠贵的屋里吃完了晚饭，回屋拾掇了一下，准备和丈夫一起出门，听说现在电影院里《七十二家房客》挺火的，她和丈夫正准备出去看，难得丈夫请客看电影，她自然要积极一点，过了这村可就没这店了。
结果刚一出门，就看到丈夫呆愣的站在那里，于是她开口问道：
“解成，你怎么了？”
阎解成有些木讷的回过了头，看着于莉开口说道：
“于莉，还记得我跟你说的，今天下午叶晨买回来一堆自行车零部件，准备组装自行车的事情吧？”
于莉点了点头，然后说道：
“当然记得，你当时还好一顿嘲笑，觉得那小子自不量力，我也觉得挺离谱的，真要是那么好组装，那还要自行车厂做什么？”
“我刚看见叶晨推着崭新的自行车出门，咱们吃饭的工夫，真叫他给干成了。”
阎解成有些羡慕的说道。
于莉听到丈夫的话，也是震惊到不行，这年月，能骑上自己的自行车的，那绝对是条件不错的那一批，整个四合院里，也就那么凤毛麟角的几个人有自行车，阎埠贵一辆，二大爷刘海中有一辆，许大茂有一辆，何雨水有一辆，可这几个哪个都是有着丰厚积累的。
阎埠贵是个资深的老抠门，而且极会钻营，挖门盗洞搞到了一张自行车票；二大爷刘海中那是厂里的七级锻工，虽说比不了易中海，那也是妥妥的高收入人群；许大茂是厂里的电影放映员，在这个年代，他的活是最清闲的，而且油水颇多，跟领导的关系处的极好；至于何雨水的那辆，是托了她哥傻柱的福。
而叶晨作为一个生态链最底层的存在，居然也给自己名正言顺的弄了一辆自行车，这就难免让人羡慕嫉妒恨了，可是这群人能做的也只是眼巴巴的瞅着，哪怕知道他是怎么做到的，他们也整不了，要不然修车铺的生意岂不是会瞬间火爆了？实在是没有那两下子，哪怕是修车匠在这个年月，撑死帮你换换车胎，指望他们给你组装个自行车，那就是个笑话。

content_en:
With the help of the leg puller, Ye Chen moved all the bicycle parts into his house. If the season changes, he might be able to operate it outside. If he still runs outside to get better at this season, it is purely cheating and irresponsible for his own body. Ye Chen will definitely not do such a heartless thing.
After moving the parts, Ye Chen handed the foot puller a cigarette, poured him a glass of water, and said:
"Master, thank you very much for today. Otherwise, if I had to do all this work myself, I would definitely have a headache!"
At this time, I saw the foot puller taking the cigarettes handed over by Ye Chen. He was not interested in drinking water. After all, it was freezing cold. There was no fire in the house yet, and there was no possibility of hot water. He came to Ye Chen, lit a fire, took a puff of cigarette, and said:
"You're too polite. This is what I do, and I look after customers like you. Next time you have such a job, just ask me."
Ye Chen smiled and nodded in agreement, and then sent the foot puller out of the yard. The time he went in and out allowed Yan Jiecheng to see clearly and asked:
"Ye Chen, what did you buy? I'm not old or young when it comes to things!"
Regarding this kind of thing, Ye Chen didn't even think about hiding it, and said directly:
“I went to the hardware store and bought some bicycle parts, planning to buy myself a bicycle to ride.
After all, you need a bicycle ticket to buy a bicycle. If you save it yourself, just buying parts is enough. "
After Yan Jiecheng heard what Ye Chen said, his jaw dropped. He didn't expect Ye Chen to have such an idea. In his opinion, he was just listening to the myth. Can this thing be done by himself? He felt that Ye Chen was talking nonsense to him, so he didn't pay any more attention to it and went back to the house.
Ye Chen smiled and didn't pay any more attention to it. The ability of people in this era to accept emerging things is still incomparable with that of later generations, and seeing this kind of thing is believing, hearing is believing, and disbelief is the norm.
Back in the house, Ye Chen changed himself into a set of work clothes, then put on sleeves and gloves and started his project.
Ye Chen had already had the idea of ​​assembling a bicycle, so he naturally made preparations in advance. He bought a pack of cigarettes for the workshop director. With the help of his master, he made himself many small tools, such as wire wrenches, hexagonal socket wrenches, hexagonal screwdrivers, flower wrenches, steel chisels, etc. while turning a blind eye.
In fact, assembling a bicycle is really difficult. If you know how to do it, it is not difficult. If you don't say anything else, take a simple spoke. It seems very simple to you, but you will know how difficult it is only when you actually get started. This kind of thing is completely impossible to understand without practice.
Ye Chen bought all kinds of spare parts that could no longer be scattered, which would save a lot of costs. Take a bicycle wheel as an example. In the TV series, Silly Zhu secretly removed the third uncle Yan Bugui's wheel and sold it. In the end, Yi Zhonghai bought one at a car repair shop for five yuan. Ye Chen only spent less than three yuan on the spokes and steel rims with extra belt, saving nearly half of the cost at once.
Ye Chen's hands were seen weaving spokes as if they were threading butterflies. After a while, one wheel was finished and then the next one started.
After everything was knitted, Ye Chen started to put the tires on the steel rims. It took a few minutes to put them on.
Then Ye Chen started to perform the following steps...
Two hours later, Ye Chen finally put the seat on the bike, and a brand new permanent brand manganese steel 28-bar bicycle stood in front of him. Ye Chen used the newly bought pump to inflate the bike, then washed his hands with the diesel he brought back some time ago, wiped them clean with cotton gauze, then took the kettle from the honeycomb stove, mixed some cold water, washed it again, and changed his clothes., planning to go for a ride on the bicycle and reward myself by the way, after all, I have missed my meal.
When Ye Chen appeared in the yard pushing a brand new 28-inch bicycle, Yan Jiecheng had just finished dinner and was about to go out for a walk. He saw Ye Chen's bicycle at a glance. Yan Jiecheng's eyes were straightened. He felt like he was watching a magic trick. In the afternoon, he saw with his own eyes Ye Chen and the leg puller pulling back a pile of parts. When he turned around, the boy actually turned into a bicycle.
Yan Jiecheng's wife Yu Li and her husband finished dinner at Yan Bugui's house and went back to tidy up before going out with her husband. She heard that the movie "Seventy-Two Tenants" was very popular now. She and her husband were about to go out to watch it. It was rare for her husband to treat guests to a movie, so she naturally had to be more active. After passing this village, there was no such store.
As soon as she went out, she saw her husband standing there blankly, so she asked:
"Jie Cheng, what's wrong with you?"
Yan Jiecheng turned his head somewhat dully, looked at Yu Li and said:
"Yu Li, do you remember what I told you about Ye Chen buying a bunch of bicycle parts this afternoon and preparing to assemble the bicycle?"
Yu Li nodded and then said:
"Of course I remember. You laughed at me and thought that guy was overestimating his abilities. I also thought it was outrageous. If it was so easy to assemble, then what else would a bicycle factory do?"
"I just saw Ye Chen pushing his brand new bicycle out. He really did it while we were eating."
Yan Jiecheng said with some envy.
Yu Li was extremely shocked when she heard her husband's words. In these days, those who can ride their own bicycles are definitely the ones with good conditions. In the entire courtyard, there are only a handful of people who have bicycles. Yan Bugui has one, the second uncle Liu Haizhong has one, Xu Damao has one, and He Yuyu has one. But all of them have rich accumulations.
Yan Bugui is a veteran stingy, and he is very good at digging and stealing, and he got a bicycle ticket; the second uncle, Liu Haizhong, is a seventh-level blacksmith in the factory. Although he is not as good as Yi Zhonghai, he still has a decently high income. Crowd; Xu Damao is a movie projectionist in the factory. In this era, his job is the most leisurely, and he has a lot of money, and has an excellent relationship with the leaders; as for He Yuyu’s car, it is thanks to her brother Shazhu.
As a person at the bottom of the ecological chain, Ye Chen actually got himself a bicycle, which is inevitable, which makes people envious and jealous. But all these people can do is watch helplessly. Even if they know how he did it, they can't stop it. Otherwise, wouldn't the business of the car repair shop become booming in an instant? It's really not possible to do that. Even if a bicycle repairman is willing to help you change a tire in this day and age, it would be a joke to expect them to assemble a bicycle for you.
